record.title: Validate precise execution stops after uninterrupted private atomic operations
record.intent: Establish a post-sequence observation boundary that preserves exclusive-store progress.
requirements: Fresh pinned disposable guest; private controls only, no Sparrow launch or device responses.
Place execution breakpoint after the entire bounded exclusive sequence; never between the exclusive load and store.
Preserve the stock APK and native library and retain guest enforcement and host policy.
Same private executable and fixed inputs across continuous baseline, matching breakpoint and nonmatching breakpoint controls.
At most eight exclusive attempts and one observed terminal stop per arm, with a 30-second host command bound.
Preserve unsupported breakpoint operations and unexpected stops as outcomes without changing the question mid-run.
acceptance: Pin reference ABI sources and distinguish upstream reference from actual guest behavior.
Capture debug-register availability, requested and read-back state, final PC and signal metadata.
Establish whether the exclusive store succeeds before the intended execution breakpoint fires.
Independently verify same executable, terminal state, matching versus nonmatching stop classification and preservation.
